scope: Exact copies of independent audit scripts used in this session. v1 generated the original cumulative core audit snapshots; current main auditor differs only in shortening future output basenames. Policy checker was additionally run over completed core cohorts. They read retained raw traces and write new audit artifacts; they do not call model APIs or execute candidate programs.
